title: Efficient equivariant framework for universal charge density prediction
title_zh: 高效等变框架的普遍电荷密度预测
abstract: Accelerating materials discovery requires efficient electronic structure calculations, which remain a critical challenge owing to the high computational cost of density functional theory. While charge density plays a central role in determining electronic structures in density functional theory, existing generalizable machine learning (ML) charge density models are hindered by prohibitive computational costs. Here we present the Equivariant Density Graph Neural Network (EdenGNN), an ML charge density model for electronic structure to overcome these limitations. It predicts both charge density and augmentation occupancies, enabling electronic structure calculations with projector augmented-wave accuracy. Critically, by using a basis-expansion formulation with fully trainable radial basis functions and a Δ-learning strategy to capture charge transfer, it is more than an order of magnitude faster. Notably, trained on the Materials Project database, our universal model for non-magnetic structures across the periodic table, EdenGNN-Uni, accurately predicts the band structures for most unseen materials across a vast chemical space, demonstrating enhanced robustness over universal ML Hamiltonian methods. These findings establish the ML charge density model as a scalable ab initio method for large-scale electronic structure calculations and high-throughput screening. Li et al. introduce EdenGNN-Uni, a universal charge density model for the periodic table that is over an order of magnitude faster than some existing methods, facilitating efficient and accurate electronic structure calculations of materials.
abstract_zh: 加速材料发现需要高效的电子结构计算，这仍然是一个关键挑战，因为密度泛函理论的高计算成本。虽然电荷密度在决定密度泛函理论中电子结构方面起着核心作用，但现有的可泛化机器学习电荷密度模型因计算成本过高而受阻。在此，我们提出了等变密度图神经网络（EdenGNN），一种用于电子结构的机器学习电荷密度模型，以克服这些局限性。它预测电荷密度和增量占用数，从而实现具有投影增广波准确性的电子结构计算。关键的是，通过使用基展开形式配合可训练的径向基函数和Δ-学习策略来捕获电荷转移，它比现有方法快一个数量级。值得注意的是，在材料项目数据库上训练的，我们针对周期表非磁性结构的通用模型EdenGNN-Uni，能够准确预测大多数在未见材料中的带结构，涵盖广阔的化学空间，这比通用机器学习哈密顿方法表现出更强的鲁棒性。这些发现确立了机器学习电荷密度模型作为大规模电子结构计算和高通量筛选的可扩展的第一性原理方法的地位。Li等人介绍了EdenGNN-Uni，这是一个比现有方法快一个数量级的周期表普遍电荷密度模型，有助于高效且准确的材料电子结构计算。
